name: agent-rd-team
description: An AI-DLC agent team for Kiro Crew that works from your company's rules. Give it a requirement: role sessions build it in parallel git worktrees, the app runs your company checks itself, a person decides at the gates, and it deploys locally. It comes with an English example company, a one-click setup, and a real sample delivery you can replay before you spend any model credits.
author: JiaDe-Wu
highlights: See it first: load a real Black Friday delivery (5.5 minutes, 9.7 credits, 38 of 38 company checks) and replay it without spending anything
One click sets up the example company: its workspace, 14 team members and its rule documents as a knowledge source
Company rules are plain files in English (pricing, margin, price-adjustment, privacy, security) and the checks that enforce them run in the app, not in the agents
Roles work in parallel, each in its own git worktree; a person decides at the gates; failed checks go back to the role that owns them
The checks, the site and git run under Kiro Crew's sandbox
A live team board, a replay of finished runs and a CTO view that says which numbers are simulated and which are measured
useCases: Trying AI-DLC on your own standards: replace the rule documents, the checks and the team file, and keep the app
Showing a team what a delivery looks like with company rules enforced, and where a person must decide
Taking a web feature from a requirement to a reviewed local deployment with people at the gates

zh-CN.description: 基于 AI-DLC、按公司规则工作的 Kiro Crew Agent 团队：给一个需求，多个角色在各自的 git 工作树里并行开发，应用自己运行公司检查，人在关卡上做决定，最后本机部署。自带英文示例公司、一键设置和一份真实的示例交付，不花模型额度就能回放。
